stem: What is the largest population to which the results of the study can be generalized?
stimulus: A researcher wanted to estimate how many hours per week students at Larkspur Conservatory spend practicing their instruments. The researcher randomly selected 150 students from all students enrolled at Larkspur Conservatory and asked each one to record their practice time for one week. On average, the students practiced 18 hours per week.
choices: The 150 students in the study
All students at Larkspur Conservatory
All conservatory students in the country
All music students in the world
explanation: The 150 students were randomly selected from all students enrolled at Larkspur Conservatory. Because the selection was random, the results can be generalized to that whole group, but not to any group the sample wasn't drawn from.

A.why: You ignored the random selection. A sample drawn at random from Larkspur's students represents all Larkspur students, not just the 150 who took part.

C.why: You went beyond the group that was sampled. Only Larkspur students could have been chosen, so students at other conservatories aren't represented.

D.why: You picked the broadest choice because it sounds impressive. The sample came only from one conservatory, so it can't speak for music students everywhere.
